caption: Pantheon, Rome
composition: Floodlit portico and piazza at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the Pantheon's floodlit portico across the wet cobbles of the piazza in the deep night of the 03:35 scenario. Eight great columns carry the triangular pediment at center, the ancient inscription legible across its frieze, with the dark swell of the dome rising behind and the obelisk and fountain standing in the middle ground. Lamp-lit palazzi close in on both sides, their amber windows glowing, and the rain-slicked stones mirror the floodlights beneath the black sky.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Pantheon in Rome floodlit at night from Piazza della Rotonda
